level_description: Deterministic-Offload Showcase (Deliberately NOT a test of constrained-generation accuracy -- it is a test of a different, separate claim: that the AOT compiler can safely detect when a field is fully derivable from already-generated fields and compute it exactly, removing it from the LLM's generation path entirely rather than trusting next-token arithmetic. Each schema here is realistic but intentionally weighted toward derived fields, the mirror image of the realworld2/dependency_chains sets. Read this set's results alongside, not instead of, the low-bypass sets -- the headline 'does constrained generation work' claim should rest on those, not on this one.)

OFF_sales_commission_payroll.name: Sales Commission Payroll Calculation
OFF_sales_commission_payroll.description: A commission-based payroll slip: base salary, sales figures, and rates are the only genuine inputs; commission, gross pay, tax withheld, and net pay are all exact linear functions of them. A real payroll system would compute these in code, not ask an LLM to -- this schema demonstrates that invariants can make the same call automatically from one DSL spec, without a hand-written post-processing step.

prompts.system: You are a payroll system generating a validated commission-based pay stub. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate a commission-based payroll record for a sales employee. Compute commission, gross pay, tax withheld, and net pay exactly.

OFF_forex_conversion_fee.name: Foreign Exchange Conversion & Fee
OFF_forex_conversion_fee.description: A currency conversion transaction: source amount, exchange rate, and fee percentage are the genuine inputs; converted amount, fee amount, and net amount are exact derived values. Same offload story as the payroll case, different domain.

prompts.system: You are a foreign exchange platform generating a validated currency conversion transaction. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate a currency conversion transaction. Compute the converted amount, fee, and net amount exactly.

OFF_utility_bill_calculation.name: Utility Bill Calculation
OFF_utility_bill_calculation.description: A utility bill: usage, rate, and fixed service charge are genuine inputs; energy cost and total bill are exact derived values. Third domain for the same offload claim, kept simple deliberately.

prompts.system: You are a utility billing system generating a validated bill. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate a utility bill for a metered customer. Compute the energy cost and total bill exactly.
